pairs.subject: Mandatory HR Training Session
pairs.desc:
Dear Team,

We are pleased to announce a mandatory training session on workplace safety scheduled for next Thursday at 10 AM in the main conference room. This training is essential for ensuring a safe working environment for all employees.

Please find the training materials attached to this email. Make sure to review them before the session. Attendance will be taken, and those who do not attend will need to reschedule.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Best regards,

HR Department
pairs.explain: The email is from the HR department and contains a legitimate attachment related to mandatory training.
